newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices edge up in sparse trade.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices edge up in sparse trade.

text.p: Danish bond prices edged up on Friday in thin holiday trade expected to peter out completely in the early afternoon.
At 1040 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 traded at 109.79 -- yielding 6.54 percent -- up from Monday's closing 109.71.
Turnover in the benchmark was a thin 270 million crowns.
Its March future rose 0.17 point to 108.95, with 30 contracts traded.
The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 rose 0.23 point to 86.88, yielding 7.75 percent.
The crown traded at 3.8250 per mark, unchanged from its opening level but firmer than Monday's 3.8263.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany narrowed further, to 75 basis points from its earlier 76 and Monday's 78 bp. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969650
